# World Health Organization (WHO)

> The WHO provides global public health guidance, disease information, and health interventions across communicable and non-communicable diseases through comprehensive resources and regional offices.

WHO.int serves as the primary digital hub for the World Health Organization, offering evidence-based health information, technical guidance, and public health resources to support global health initiatives. The site covers disease prevention, health systems strengthening, and regional health programs across 194 member states.

## Key Topics

- Public Health
- Communicable Diseases
- Non-Communicable Diseases
- Disease Prevention
- Health Systems
- COVID-19
- Mpox
- Health Interventions
- Disease Information
- Health Resources
- WHO/Europe
- European Region
- Health Topics Directory
- Viral Infections
- Symptoms and Treatment

## Health Topics & Directory

- [Health topics](https://www.who.int/health-topics): Primary health topics resource covering diseases and health systems
- [Health topics](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics): Directory of WHO health topics covering diseases and interventions
- [Popular health topics](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular): Popular health topics directory for communicable diseases

## Resources & Reference Materials

- [Resources](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources): WHO resource library with data, guidance, and educational tools
- [Fact sheets](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/fact-sheets): Fact sheets on diseases and health conditions with mRNA vaccines
- [Publications](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/publications): Publications library including guidelines and research documents
- [Tools and toolkits](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/tools-and-toolkits): Health tools and toolkits for disease prevention and data collection

## Multimedia & Educational Content

- [Facts in pictures](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/facts-in-pictures): Visual infographics and educational resources on health topics
- [Multimedia](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/multimedia): Multimedia content library with videos and audio resources
- [Podcasts](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/podcasts): Podcast series on COVID-19, disease prevention, and global health

## Disease-Specific Information

- [Dengue](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/dengue): Dengue fact sheet with symptoms, diagnostics, and prevention
- [Herpes simplex virus](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/herpes): HSV-1 and HSV-2 fact sheet with transmission and treatment info
- [Endometriosis](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/endometriosis): Endometriosis fact sheet covering diagnosis and treatment options
- [Heat and health](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/excessive-heat): Heat and health factsheet on climate change and heat-related illness
- [Mental disorders](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/mental-disorders): Mental disorders fact sheet covering anxiety, depression, and ICD-11

## Regional Offices

- [WHO/Europe](https://www.who.int/europe): WHO Regional Office for Europe homepage serving 53 countries
